description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys load session functionality in the Rialto media server, specifically testing success and failure scenarios of the loadSession method.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysLoadSessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysTestBase, setting up media keys and key session for testing loadSession behavior.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysLoadSessionTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing media keys and key session for tests.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaKeysLoadSessionTest
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up media keys after tests.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test case verifying that loadSession succeeds when the session loads successfully.

methods.name: SessionDoesNotExistFailure
methods.description: Test case verifying that loadSession fails with BAD_SESSION_ID when the session does not exist.

methods.name: SessionFailure
methods.description: Test case verifying that loadSession fails with NOT_SUPPORTED when the session API fails.
